python3 << 'EOF'
# Treasury data values (in millions of nominal dollars)
# June 1991
europe_1991 = 268166
latam_1991 = 337565

# June 1996
europe_1996 = 426245
latam_1996 = 443872

# Calculate linear regression coefficients
# Using the two data points, slope b = (y2-y1)/(x2-x1)
# and intercept a = y1 - b*x1
import math

# For two points, regression is exactly the line through them
slope = (latam_1996 - latam_1991) / (europe_1996 - europe_1991)
intercept = latam_1991 - slope * europe_1991

print(f"Slope (b): {slope}")
print(f"Intercept (a): {intercept}")

# Germany GDP (World Bank data, in current USD)
gdp_1991 = 1875792575132.59  # USD
gdp_1996 = 2506576553158.31  # USD

# Convert to billions and round to 2 decimal places
gdp_1991_billions = round(gdp_1991 / 1e9, 2)
gdp_1996_billions = round(gdp_1996 / 1e9, 2)

print(f"\nGermany nominal GDP:")
print(f"1991: {gdp_1991_billions} billion USD")
print(f"1996: {gdp_1996_billions} billion USD")

# Calculate Germany's percentage growth rate
germany_growth_rate = ((gdp_1996_billions - gdp_1991_billions) / gdp_1991_billions) * 100
print(f"\nGermany GDP growth rate (%): {germany_growth_rate}")

# Apply growth rate to June 1991 Europe value to create counterfactual
# counterfactual Europe value = europe_1991 * (1 + growth_rate)
counterfactual_europe = europe_1991 * (1 + germany_growth_rate/100)
print(f"\nJune 1991 Europe value: {europe_1991}")
print(f"Counterfactual Europe (1991 + Germany growth): {counterfactual_europe}")

# Use regression to predict corresponding Latin America value
predicted_latam = intercept + slope * counterfactual_europe
print(f"\nPredicted Latin America (counterfactual): {predicted_latam}")

# Calculate absolute difference from actual June 1996 Latin America value
actual_latam_1996 = latam_1996
absolute_difference = abs(predicted_latam - actual_latam_1996)
print(f"\nActual June 1996 Latin America: {actual_latam_1996}")
print(f"Absolute difference: {absolute_difference}")

# Express difference as percentage of actual June 1996 value
percentage_diff = (absolute_difference / actual_latam_1996) * 100
print(f"Percentage difference: {percentage_diff}")

# Calculate U.S. total liabilities growth ratio (Europe + Latin America proxy)
total_liabilities_1991 = europe_1991 + latam_1991
total_liabilities_1996 = europe_1996 + latam_1996
us_liabilities_growth = total_liabilities_1996 / total_liabilities_1991
print(f"\nU.S. total liabilities growth ratio: {us_liabilities_growth}")

# Germany's nominal GDP growth ratio
germany_gdp_ratio = gdp_1996_billions / gdp_1991_billions
print(f"Germany GDP growth ratio: {germany_gdp_ratio}")

# Calculate final result: percentage_diff * (us_liabilities_growth / germany_gdp_ratio)
result = percentage_diff * (us_liabilities_growth / germany_gdp_ratio)
print(f"\nFinal result: {result}")
print(f"Rounded to 2 decimal places: {round(result, 2)}")
EOF
